answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one saffron weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, someone who spins up 111 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 207 times the capital for one share. The dune report reveals the merge explicitly at each knoll. A farm of 1814 identities would post 4681 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
